description: FREE. Read saved leads with what enrichment found: business email and its verification state, named contact (name, title, email and its state), the relevance verdict with the sentence from the business's own site, software (CMS, CRM, booking, chat, email marketing), technologies and signals. Pass the search_id from search_leads to read that search; wait_seconds (up to 45) first waits for enrichment still running on it. Returns a compact view with a summary and next steps; detail "full" returns every field.

detail.description: compact (default) or full (every field, much longer)

search_id.description: Batch id returned by search_leads (optional: omit for all results)

wait_seconds.description: With search_id: wait up to this many seconds for enrichment to finish before reading. 40 right after search_leads.

name: list_results
title: List saved leads
